about_the_game:
Step up as the rising star of the Drone Football League, for some arcade soccer meets arena shooter, team red vs blue mayhem. Easy to understand but hard to master. Dronaldo includes fully featured casual and competitive game modes, with single player and both local and online multiplayer modes.

There is one ball always bouncing around and one goal in the centre of each arena, Touching the ball will absorb it and turn it to your team colour, Red or Blue. The ball is purple when neutral. If you shoot the ball into the goal without hitting an obstacle, You score for your team.

Different arenas provide different obstacles and different ways of moving and fighting, for example curved arenas, let you add driving up the walls to all your other methods of moving, jumping, boosting and flying!

Use your weapons, offensive, defensive and mobility abilities to literally fight for the win, Damaging an opponent with the ball will tackle them. Opponents always respawn after a short while when destroyed.
detailed_description:
Just Updated

Update v0.0.17a

Medium drone line ups now have art!
It's so great to finally put a face and a personality to each drone in the medium class!

Update v0.0.16a

The class line up has been decided, and is five strong.
We can't wait to see what each faction does with each.

  • Tank - The heavy damage sponge of the team, High defence, High HP but very low mobility, Plan ahead where you will make the most impact, because repositioning is slow.

  • Warrior - Balanced all-rounder drones that excel by having no weaknesses but have an answer for every situation.

  • Ranger - Rain down heavy damage from afar, A glass cannon that controls the field from distant cover.

  • Rogue - Slip in from the blind spot, Steal the ball or dish out damage and be gone in the blink of an eye, All in on agility and damage.

  • Cleric - Mobile support mechanic drones, Heals, Buffs, Debuffs and tricks of every kind, So powerful, These drones are almost required in every team.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 (64 bit) or Newer (64 bit) Windows OS
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz Dual core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 760, AMD Radeon R7 270X, or better
  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: Dronaldo is a team sports game blended with an arena shooter, Race around in drone teams that compete to score goals and rack up kill counts utilising class skills, Like buffs, heals and teleports to get to that winning formula. Matches are 4 minutes long and always 3 drones per team.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish
